facts.statement: An exact rank-one crossing of singular value sigma between two disjoint original-coordinate product banks, with arbitrary same-bank functions, obeys sup_s P(|R-s|<rho) <= 7.108629 sigma^(-1/2) sqrt(rho).
Account01/B04 r20 at math-open-problems commit 5d4cd3fcb9976deebd0cb409ebcca9cfb29cb9ba proves the stronger rank-free first-compound pair receiver ||p_Q||_inf <15.829(D kappa)^(-1/4)||N||_F^(-1/4).

In the r45 common-plane geometry N=M1^T(R_c-B^{-1})M2+T with P1TP2=0, the exact identity ||N||_F^2=||M1^T(R_c-B^{-1})M2||_F^2+||T||_F^2 holds, so N=0 iff R_c=B^{-1} and T=0 when both arms have full row rank.
Every invertible-indefinite r45 branch with N nonzero has essential density bound <15.829(D kappa)^(-1/4)[beta1^2 beta2^2||R_c-B^{-1}||_F^2+||T||_F^2]^(-1/8).
The target-valid diffuse family 2LUV+2L(r.X)(r.Y), r=(1,...,1)/sqrt(m), has nonzero spectrum {-L,-L,L,L} and essential density bound <15.083/L while every light-light coefficient is L/m.
Designated partner account04/B08 gives ||p_(LX0^2+2LRU1V1+2LR^{-1}U2V2)||_inf<7.251/L for R>=3.
